notes: Conservative OBC/data-handling tier capacities for first-pass CubeSat optimization.
supported_ingest_mbps is a practical sustained ingest/processing pipeline proxy, not a raw interface maximum.
max_storage_gb is usable storage capacity for mission data (filesystem overhead handled elsewhere).

obc_tiers.compute_class_description: Single MCU-class OBC (basic flight software, low-rate payload IO).
Higher-performance MCU/SoC with RTOS and improved autonomy; moderate-rate payload data handling.
FPGA-assisted or high-performance compute OBC; high-rate buffering and advanced payload processing.
High-performance compute + robust data pipeline and fault management; supports extreme-rate payload ingest and processing.

field_descriptions.max_storage_gb: Maximum usable onboard storage for mission data used to satisfy D_store_req_GB feasibility.
field_descriptions.supported_ingest_mbps: Sustained ingest/processing pipeline proxy used to screen compute/data handling feasibility.
field_descriptions.fault_tolerance_level: Qualitative fault tolerance / redundancy expectation for the tier.
